issue.title: Restore and reassess Harare city territory sources
issue.body:
The review in #413 reconciled all 91 geoBoundaries ZWE ADM2 source features: 87 standalone Atlas district rows and four source members inside `atlas:city:ZWE-525` (`62879985B31454704835515` Chitungwiza; `62879985B25596949610081` Epworth; `62879985B33947363062254` Harare; `62879985B75244512710705` Harare Rural). Pinned Natural Earth 10m feature `ZWE-525` says `name=Harare`, `type=City`, and `gn_name=Harare Province`. ZIMSTAT’s 2022 census report lists Harare Province with Harare Urban, Chitungwiza Urban, and Epworth. The current packet cannot decide whether this is a suitable metropolitan city territory or an over-broad repeated province tier, and has no rights-cleared compatible-vintage vector source for the City of Harare.

Parent: #413; regional integration umbrella: #410.

Acceptance:
- Restore an authoritative, compatible-vintage source that distinguishes the City of Harare/metropolitan territory from Harare Province and its subordinate districts; inspect the source's role, parent relationships, boundary date, completeness, and redistribution terms.
- Retain lawful original bytes or exact restoration URL, retrieval date, payload SHA-256, license/attribution, and a reproducible crosswalk for `atlas:city:ZWE-525`, its Harare province parent, and the four listed source ADM2 members.
- Classify the current city-tier relationship as justified, correction-needed, or insufficient-evidence, with geometry limits stated. Do not infer legal boundaries from Natural Earth type labels, map counts, overlaps, or source ID joins alone.
- Deliver a bounded sourced engineering handoff if an Atlas identity, parent, tier, or footprint correction is supported. Keep research-only scope; do not edit shared geography, authorize historical imports, or certify the region.

Source leads from #413: ZIMSTAT 2022 district report (https://www.zimstat.co.zw/wp-content/uploads/Census/2022_Population_Distribution_by_District_Ward_SexandHouseholds_23012023.pdf); Zimbabwe National Geoportal listing the ZIMSTAT/OCHA/ITOS geodatabase `zwe_adm_zimstat_ocha_itos_20180911.gdb` (https://zimgeoportal.org.zw/datasets/zimbabwe-administrative-boundaries/; portal login required); pinned Natural Earth source (https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/tree/ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19). No compatible official city boundary source or license has yet been restored.

This follow-up depends on completion of the #413 source/semantic review. It is intentionally blocked until #413 closes and this source-restoration scope receives a separate readiness review.
